title: Tanzanian Coconut Lentils
community: Coastal Tanzania — the quick coastal lentil dish
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Dengu ya Nazi — red lentils simmered in coconut milk with Zanzibar spices. The coastal version of lentil curry — richer and more fragrant than the plain version, and ready in 25 minutes.
longDesc: Coconut lentil curry is the quick, rich, satisfying coastal dish — the lentils need no soaking, the coconut milk goes in at the end, and within 25 minutes there is a dish of extraordinary flavour on the table.
steps: Heat oil. Cook onions until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, spices. Stir 1 minute.
Add lentils and water. Simmer 18—20 minutes until completely soft.
Add coconut milk. Simmer gently 5 minutes.
chefTips: Red lentils dissolve into creaminess — this is correct.
Add coconut milk only after lentils are fully cooked.
cookingScience: See TZA102 for lentil cooking science.
sustainabilityTips: Red lentils cook in 20 minutes — very low energy footprint.
culturalNote: Coconut lentil curry is the quick coastal meal — ready faster than any other substantial dish, yet carrying the full flavour of the Zanzibar spice tradition.
